reference_standard.name: WCAG
reference_standard.target_level: Determine the applicable target and legal requirements for the project.
reference_standard.note: This is a testing reference. Do not claim full conformance from automated scans alone.

checks: All interactive controls are keyboard operable.
Focus is visible and moves in a logical order.
Dialogs and menus manage focus correctly.
Instructions and validation errors are understandable.
Errors are communicated without relying only on color.
Content remains usable at supported zoom levels.
Meaning is not conveyed through color alone.
Semantic structure and headings are meaningful.
Status messages and dynamic changes are announced where required.
Booking and inquiry forms are accessible.
Critical instructions are readable and understandable.
Authentication and error recovery are tested.
Time limits and session expiration are handled appropriately.

rules: Automated scans detect only some accessibility issues.
Prioritize blockers affecting essential user tasks.
Do not mark a page fully accessible based only on a passing scan.
Record unresolved findings and their owners.
Use synthetic test accounts and non-sensitive data.
